description: Multi-language ADXL355 accelerometer driver family for C, C++, Python, Rust, TypeScript/Node.js and Go, with SPI/I2C device transports, tested register semantics and opt-in hardware-in-the-loop verification. Alpha-stage software.
description_good_justification: ADXL355 driver family and its capabilities and alpha scope are described in https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/blob/main/README.md.
documentation_interface_justification: Generated reference documentation covers all six public language interfaces at https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/blob/main/docs/api/README.md.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Debug C/C++ CI builds use warnings-as-errors and sanitizer fail-fast configuration; https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No confirmed medium-or-higher exploitable sanitizer/fuzz finding is open at the last verified CI baseline: https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml.
dynamic_analysis_justification: AddressSanitizer, UBSan and bounded libFuzzer smoke are in https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: C/C++ memory-unsafe code is exercised under ASan/UBSan and libFuzzer smoke: https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml and https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/blob/main/c/fuzz/fuzz_adxl355.c.
english_justification: Project README, documentation, contribution instructions, and GitHub issues are available in English: https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/blob/main/README.md.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are tracked alongside the issue backlog; GitHub issues review on 2026-11-04 found 41 of 43 overall public issues resolved and no external human reporter issues: https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/issues?state=all.
interact_justification: Install/build from https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/blob/main/README.md; bug reports at https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/issues; contribution guide https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
maintained_justification: Active commits, CI, recent dependency security fixes and issue triage: https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/pulls and https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/actions.

test_justification: All six language automated tests and exact shared-vector verification run on pull requests; https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml and https://github.com/oaslananka/adxl355/blob/main/docs/testing.md.
